kept.issue_description: Owner reported sudden deceleration on the highway about three months after purchase; after four days of inspection the workshop first blamed a condenser in front of the turbocharger, then reversed its conclusion and blamed poor-quality fuel, which the owner disputed.
kept.frequency_signal: isolated report (one owner incident covered by two media outlets)
kept.source: 新浪财经 / 凤凰网江西

kept.issue_description: Vehicle fault light illuminated; fault code read as transmission pump failure, and the owner was told the transmission needed replacement.
While driving near Hebei Guanting service area, the vehicle suffered a sudden transmission failure and could not be put into gear or driven; a rescue followed.
Owner reported unexplained noises from the centre console, doors, chassis and other areas while driving; repeated 4S shop inspections did not fully resolve the source of the noise.
Complaint-volume data reported 231 complaints for the model in March 2024, ranking it 10th among models for that period; coverage attributed the complaints to matters including price changes.
